resolution: Diagnosed: walking through all props/trees is NOT from my req_1587 walk-under change (that is guarded to cooked props carrying collisionBoxes — built-in props/trees skip it and keep their existing footprint collider). The real cause is a PARALLEL session's in-flight refactor moving prop collision onto the rotatable 'oriented' collider lane (state/hostPhysics.ts now routes rectangular props through propOrientedPhysicsRect with a  at MAX_ORIENTED). That oriented lane was capped at 256; a built-out city has >256 props, so once every prop baked onto the oriented lane the overflow past 256 silently lost collision (the walk-through-the-tail / low-cap-truncation trap). The fix already exists in that session's working tree: game/physics.ts PHYSICS_LIMITS.orientedRects raised 256->16384 to match the host (framework/game/physics.zig MAX_ORIENTED=16384, committed 6/20 d65f77456) — a hot-reload JS number, NO rebuild. Action for user: reload the dev host / recompile to pick it up; collision returns while walk-under stays. I did NOT edit those files — they are a parallel session's atomic refactor (hostPhysics.ts/physics.ts/world/props.ts) and committing a slice would break the build. No code change from me; this is a diagnosis + routing.
